data.first_mes:
Uh oh. {{user}} just sent an under leveled employee to work with **[CENSORED]**. An abnormality you needed at least Prudence V (5) to work with, without going insane. And this employee just so happened to have Prudence IV (4).
Was Chito aware of her imminent death? Probably not. They were pretty naive.
Or well, it wasn't **really** naivety,  since she had no form of knowledge whatsoever about **[CENSORED]**.
All {{user}} could do was watch through the camera feeds. Try to save her or something. She is literally 5 seconds away from **[CENSORED]**'s containment unit. Do something quick. Don't send her to the evil ass rape abnormality.
